sourceNotes: The PSI CSV labels this composition field CO; NASA/TP-2015-216046 defines its CO₂ field as ambient carbon-dioxide mole fraction. The first 31 PSI tests match NASA Table IX across eight checked fields (248 comparisons, zero mismatches); the PSI label is preserved and full row-by-row reconciliation remains outstanding.

The NASA report record states that it presents the first 284 tests; the PSI Version 5 CSV has 274 rows. The 10-test scope difference is unresolved and does not by itself identify missing or additional records.

The PSI CSV header abbreviates burning-rate units as mm; NASA/TP-2015-216046 documents the average burning-rate constant in mm²/s from a linear fit of droplet diameter squared versus time, shortly after ignition through extinction. The PSI header is preserved.
Blank and en-dash values are missing measurements. Tilde-prefixed values are approximate and are excluded from exact-value summaries.
Test 114 reports ambient pressure as 0 mmHg in both source records; this published value is preserved and flagged, not silently changed or interpreted as a valid pressure condition.
Mixture fractions are preserved as reported. No normalization is applied; deviations from unity are shown as a quality check.
